subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this broad signed-thinking replay umbrella remain open until a prevention PR lands, or should maintainers make a narrower issue such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 the canonical remaining tracker now?
rationale: The recovery-carrier fixes are merged, but current main still preserves Claude-family signed thinking on replay and multiple open PRs propose different prevention boundaries with provider/session compatibility impact.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until one maintainer-approved prevention PR lands or the remaining variants are formally split.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue as superseded only after maintainers explicitly accept a narrower open issue or PR as the owner for the remaining prevention work.

options.title: Defer Prevention Policy
options.body: Treat the merged recovery work as enough for now and keep prevention in a later provider replay review, accepting that current main still has the replay surface.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until one maintainer-approved prevention PR lands or the remaining variants are formally split.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged recovery work makes mmyzwl the clearest source-history routing point among the identified owners if maintainers need a technical handoff.
